evals.prompt: This is a Next.js 15 project with no CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md yet. Inject Next.js docs for the AI agent.
assertions: Detects the Next.js dependency and version from package.json before running anything
Since neither CLAUDE.md nor AGENTS.md exists, targets CLAUDE.md as the file to create
Runs `npx @next/codemod@canary agents-md --output CLAUDE.md` (or the equivalent with the correct --output target) rather than the FastAPI script
Reads CLAUDE.md back after the command and confirms it now contains injected Next.js documentation content, rather than declaring success from exit code alone
Final report states the detected Next.js version and that CLAUDE.md was created, with an approximate size

evals.prompt: This FastAPI project already has a CLAUDE.md with a stale '## FastAPI Best Practices' section (from months ago) plus unrelated '## Deployment' and '## Testing Conventions' sections. Refresh the FastAPI best-practices section.
assertions: Detects FastAPI from pyproject.toml or requirements.txt and targets the existing CLAUDE.md rather than creating a new file
Runs the bundled inject_fastapi_docs.py script using this skill's own absolute directory path, not a `$(dirname "$0")`-style relative trick

Does not hand-write or fabricate the FastAPI best-practices content itself — the injected content comes from running the script (which reads references/fastapi-best-practices.md), not from the agent composing new prose
After running, the old/stale FastAPI Best Practices section content is gone and replaced with the current template content
The unrelated '## Deployment' and '## Testing Conventions' sections are still present and unmodified in the final file
Final report distinguishes that the section was updated (not freshly appended) and gives an approximate size delta

evals.prompt: Inject framework docs into CLAUDE.md for this project — it's a Django app (Python, requirements.txt has django, djangorestframework, no fastapi or next anywhere).
assertions: Checks package.json, pyproject.toml, and requirements.txt for `next` or `fastapi` dependencies before concluding nothing was found
Correctly determines neither supported framework is present and stops without guessing or defaulting to one of the two injectors
Does not run `npx @next/codemod`, does not run the FastAPI injection script, and does not write to or create CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md

Final message clearly states that no supported framework (Next.js or FastAPI) was detected and that this skill only covers those two, without proposing to fabricate Django-specific content in their place
Does not claim any file was updated
